premises.text: Designers need a marketplace to sell professional-level 3D printable files for income rather than giving them away on sites like Thingiverse
premises.evidence_span: a marketplace where designers can sell professional level 3D printable files rather than just giving them away on sites like Thingiverse

premises.text: Consumers can browse, buy, download, and home-print digitized objects, or customize (e.g. size/width) and order through a network of ~1,000 print shops with pickup or shipping
premises.evidence_span: digitized objects that you can purchase, download, and manufacture right from the comfort of your home

premises.text: Buyers without printers can still get products via networked print shops that compete, commoditizing print and lowering prices
premises.evidence_span: Our system allows 3D printers to compete for your business. With competition comes commoditization, and that means lower pricing for you

premises.text: 3DLT monetizes from design sales and from profit on print fulfillment
premises.evidence_span: we generate revenue from the design and profit from the sale of print

premises.text: Customers choose when, where, and how purchased products are manufactured, yielding cheaper, greener, better-quality goods than mass manufacture
premises.evidence_span: We give you the power to choose when, where, and how the products you buy are manufactured

domains.name: buy download customize and print network

value.text: Change how people buy almost everything by letting them acquire 3D designs and manufacture on their terms
value.evidence_span: 3DLT changes the way you buy things

secondary_value.text: Designers turn passion into passive income
secondary_value.evidence_span: turn their passion into passive income

causal_links.evidence_span: open a store on 3DLT and start selling their creations
order something from across the world and literally pick it up from across the street
revenue from the design and profit from the sale of print
choose when, where, and how the products you buy are manufactured

notes: Category examples (frames/furniture/shoes) folded as catalog cascade of the buy/print path (§4.1.7). Home print and shop-network fulfillment kept together as one consumer manufacturing path; competing shops/lower price as economics of that network. Market-size/2020 flip and $10M credit promo treated as framing/GTM tactic, not premises. P5 is the buyer-power condition speakers treat as the frontier value mechanism—kept separate from marketplace ops. Four-domain partition; not a need/product/money triad.
